indicators.label: Census resident population
indicators.description: Region resident population from the census religion tabulation.
indicators.method: Sum of the eleven religion categories in the region column of each wave's table.
indicators.quality_notes: Percentages use each region's resident-population denominator. Religious affiliation is every named religion plus the report's Other category; no religion is the None category. The census Refused count stays in the denominator and outside both numerators; the two headline shares therefore do not sum to 100 percent. Tuvalu is close to universally affiliated (about 99.7 percent); the headline affiliation and no-religion metrics therefore vary little between regions; the substantive subnational contrast is denominational (a lower Ekalesia Kelisiano Tuvalu share on Funafuti than on the Outer Islands), which the shared headline metric set does not carry.
